messages.snippet: The document management system and the Leeds file server will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday
messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS and document server, Sat 15 March
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system and the Leeds file server will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 15 March for scheduled maintenance and patching. Expected downtime 3 hours. Please save and close any open documents beforehand. No action required.

IT Helpdesk
